name: Sumitomo Corporation
h1: Closing out the plan, No. 1 in each field
lede: FY2026 is the final year of Medium-Term Management Plan 2026, with a record-profit target and eight growth businesses to deliver. Airtable gives business groups one connected way to track initiatives to the finish.
why_h2: The final year of a growth plan
why_p: Record results, a higher target and a capital-efficiency agenda make initiative tracking live work right now.

signals.title: Record profit and a JPY 630 billion target
signals.body: Sumitomo Corporation reported record profit attributable to owners of JPY 600.3 billion for FY2025 and targets JPY 630 billion in FY2026, the plan's final year.
signals.angle: Final-year delivery depends on seeing every initiative, owner and risk across business groups in one place.

signals.title: Cost of capital action plan
signals.body: Sumitomo Corporation updated its action plan for management conscious of cost of capital and stock price.
signals.angle: Capital-efficiency programmes need shared tracking of initiatives and outcomes that finance and business units both trust.

signals.title: Medium-Term Management Plan 2026
signals.body: The 'No. 1 in Each Field' plan set JPY 1.8 trillion of planned investment and eight growth businesses including Digital, Healthcare and Energy Solutions.
signals.angle: Eight growth businesses and hundreds of group companies need a common layer for initiative and investment tracking.
